label: Simplified Chinese
language_name: Simplified Chinese for mainland technical learners
audience: mainland Chinese students and software developers
generation_guidance: Use natural, concise, professional Simplified Chinese. The exact approved course title is 使用 OpenShell 和 NemoClaw 构建安全智能体. Address the learner as 您 when direct address is needed. Follow the shared NVIDIA DLI translation rules and review each deterministic term in context. Preserve product names, code, commands, identifiers, paths, URLs, API fields, model IDs, placeholders, English author attributions such as Yao et al., and cited academic paper titles. Preserve complete model-selector display labels in English, including descriptive suffixes such as recommended, fast, and stronger. Translate learner-facing article titles in recommended-reading lists. Preserve Blueprint in English. Keep established interface labels exactly as displayed. For China-facing learner prose, use the generic English term coding agent instead of recommending Codex or Claude Code by name. Avoid literal English syntax, unnecessary English echoes in parentheses, redundant 我们, slogan cadence, and stacked noun phrases.

editorial_examples.source: An agent connects a model to tools, memory, and a routing decision that repeats until its task is done.
editorial_examples.target: 智能体将模型与工具、记忆和路由决策连接起来，并不断重复这一过程，直到完成任务。

editorial_examples.source: Calls do not share state. Between requests the server holds nothing for you.
editorial_examples.target: 各次调用不共享状态。两次请求之间，服务器不会替您保留任何内容。

editorial_examples.source: Choose the smallest technique that supplies the missing signal.
editorial_examples.target: 选择能提供缺失信号的最小可行技术。

review_protocol.native_editorial_signal: The shared DLI style preferences and the requester's local review govern Chinese wording. Generated text remains a draft until the requester accepts the exact rendered target.
required_dimensions: technical precision and course-wide terminology consistency
consistent learner voice using 您 for direct address
review_protocol.static_validation_limit: Static checks catch known residue, blocked calques, structure drift, and protected-token defects. They do not certify natural Chinese.
review_protocol.acceptance_boundary: Accept source and target hashes only after side-by-side rendered review of the exact target.

context_rules.Securing Agents: Use 安全智能体 for the short course title or brand line. Keep the approved full title 使用 OpenShell 和 NemoClaw 构建安全智能体 unchanged; generic agent safety still means 智能体安全.
context_rules.model selector display labels: Preserve the complete English label, including any descriptive suffix after the model name, such as recommended, fast, or stronger. This exception applies only to model-selection dropdown labels; translate the same adjectives normally in prose.
context_rules.Instrumentation: In the helpers menu, where the section contains trace and log, use 追踪与日志 instead of 插桩. In prose, translate by function as 监测、检测 or 可观测性 rather than forcing one literal term.
context_rules.sandbox: Preserve sandbox when naming the OpenShell isolation object; use 沙箱 only in a generic explanatory phrase when it is clearer.
context_rules.agent: Use 智能体 for AI/software agents. Use 代理 only for network proxy or delegated-representation meanings.
context_rules.prompt: Use 提示词 in learner prose; preserve prompt in identifiers, UI labels that must match the source product, and code.
context_rules.runtime: Use 运行时 for the technical component and 运行期间 for the adverbial meaning at runtime.
context_rules.workflow: Use 工作流 in learner prose; preserve it only in identifiers or exact product labels.

unfit_phrases.插桩: In this course's helpers menu use 追踪与日志; in prose translate instrumentation by its actual function.
unfit_phrases.代理 AI: Use AI 智能体 or 智能体式 AI according to context.
unfit_phrases.工作流程: Use 工作流 in this course.
unfit_phrases.这里将: Rewrite with a natural subject, such as 本节将, or state the action directly.
unfit_phrases.在这里，我们: Usually remove 在这里 and use a direct Chinese sentence.
unfit_phrases.超越生成式 AI: Use 从生成式 AI 继续延伸 or express the actual progression.
unfit_phrases.模型的响应: Prefer 模型响应 when no contrast requires 的.
unfit_phrases.点击在: Use 点击 or 单击 followed by the object.
unfit_phrases.思维链条: Use 思维链 or 推理链 according to context.
unfit_phrases.护栏: Use 防护机制 in learner prose unless Guardrails is part of a product name.
unfit_phrases.附着到: For Docker attach, keep attach in English.
unfit_phrases.教师模型 generation failed: Executable code text must remain exactly as in the English source unless the repository's runnable-copy contract explicitly localizes it.

editorial_patterns.detail: Chinese text should not add an ASCII gap before a Chinese strong-emphasis span.
Literal English deictic phrasing remains; rewrite the sentence naturally.
Use the course terms 智能体式 AI, AI 智能体, or 智能体循环.
